count_numbers: Count from 1 to 180, one number per line. Output only the numbers, with no introduction or code fence.
count_evens: List the even integers from 2 through 360, one number per line. Output only the numbers, with no introduction or code fence.
count_triples: For each integer from 1 through 100, output a line containing that integer repeated three times, separated by spaces. Output only these lines, with no introduction or code fence.
